title: Tom in the City
text:
Tom lives in a small city. The post office is on Main Street, next to a red bank. Every morning, Tom goes to the bakery to buy bread.

The market is near the river. On Sundays, Tom and his father go there to buy fruit and vegetables. The market is big and busy, and it has a lot of people.

questions.text: When do Tom and his father go to the market?
What can we guess about Tom?
options: He does not like the city.
He likes to buy fresh food.

questions.text: Why is the market probably busy on Sundays?
options: Many people shop there on Sundays.

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell food and other goods
a place where people keep money and get financial services
a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea or a lake
a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven

paragraph_translations: Tom vive en una ciudad pequeña. La oficina de correos está en la calle Main, al lado de un banco rojo. Cada mañana, Tom va a la panadería a comprar pan.
El mercado está cerca del río. Los domingos, Tom y su padre van allí a comprar fruta y verduras. El mercado es grande y animado, y tiene mucha gente.
